The[b] Square Enix[/b]* Character Replacement Mod[size=3]

[/size][/size][size=5][size=2] -Featuring characters from Final Fantasy and Kingdom Hearts-[/size][/size][/center][/size][size=5][size=2]



[/size][/size][b][size=4][img]http://community.playstarbound.com/custom_emotes/paper.png[/img] The Story:[/size][/b]
[i]
[size=2] People from different worlds and times are gathering, but they're not travelers. These poor souls were taken from their homes, and brought together by a (probably) malignant will. [/size][/i][size=2][i]

You find yourself and your fellow prisoners in a dream-like town with no obvious escape. No one else seems to be fully aware of the situation and live life like you'd expect.[/i][i]

It's up to you to not give a flip and just enjoy the company![/i][/size][size=3][size=2]

[/size]




This mod replaces the villagers and monsters of Stardew Valley with characters from different Square Enix franchises. Feel free to request anyone or anything from a Square game.

[size=2]Keep in mind that this is going to be Nomura-centric, so get ready to live your belt and zipper dreams.[/size][/size][size=2]

[size=4]Plans:[/size]

[size=2]-Dialogue changes coming soon.[/size][/size][size=2]

-All NPC's to be replace-able, with multiple replacement character and outfit choices for each.

-Replacers for some animals, monsters, items, and scenery.

-If I'm able to figure it out, I will add extra NPC's and even monsters (if possible.)

-I might do PC hairstyles and clothes in the future but we'll just see what happens.

-This may become a JRPG mod, rather than being limited to Square, later
on. Please only make Square/Enix requests until then.[/size]
